sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Mucuna urens (haemor-
rhoidal diathesis and diseases depending thereon) :
Sedum tclephium (uterine haemorrhages, also of bowels
and rectum; menorrhagia, especially at climacteric);
Sedum repens — S. alpestre — (cancer; specific action
on abdominal organs; pain, loss of strength).
